beliefs.label: Matter Family
beliefs.statement: I matter to my family when I show up, not when I have the perfect words.

receipts.quote: Inez missed the dinner after her late shift, but she called Dad from the parking lot. He smiled through the whole short conversation.
I brought Dad's groceries after forgetting his birthday card. Carrying the bags upstairs felt more honest than my excuse.

beliefs.label: Disagreement Safer
beliefs.statement: A disagreement is safer when nobody has to win it.

receipts.quote: Dad wanted the fence painted white and I wanted cedar. I said we could test one board instead of proving either of us wrong.
Inez and I disagreed about the birthday menu. We made two lists and picked dishes from both.

beliefs.label: Learn Hard
beliefs.statement: I can learn a hard thing by trying it in public.

receipts.quote: A customer asked how to replace a faucet washer, so I tried the display fixture with him watching. We both learned where the clip sat.
I volunteered to lead the store's Spanish greeting practice even though my accent felt clumsy. By lunch I had stopped hiding behind the clipboard.

beliefs.label: Say What
beliefs.statement: I say what I can do before discussing what I cannot.

receipts.quote: Inez asked for help with Dad's forms, and I said I could scan them Wednesday. Then we talked about the rest.
A friend wanted a ride at six, so I told him I could leave work at seven. He chose the bus instead.

beliefs.label: Believe Plans
beliefs.statement: I believe plans deserve a clear owner.

receipts.quote: For Dad's appointment I made a list with Inez's name beside the call and mine beside the ride. Nobody spent the morning guessing.
The store volunteer day worked once I named who opened, who counted, and who locked up. The handoff was calm.

beliefs.label: Get Blunt
beliefs.statement: I get blunt when I think someone is dodging me.

receipts.quote: When Inez answered around my question, I said, "Please just say yes or no." I heard the edge after it left my mouth.
Dad kept changing the plan, and I asked him what he was avoiding. The room went quiet.

beliefs.label: Practical Help
beliefs.statement: Practical help should leave people more capable next time.

receipts.quote: A customer bought a drill, so I showed her how to change the bit before she left. She returned later to say she had hung the shelf herself.
I wrote the steps for patching drywall on a scrap board. The teenager followed them without asking me to take over.

beliefs.label: Save Money
beliefs.statement: I save money for time with people, not upgrades.

receipts.quote: I chose the cheaper flight so I could visit Inez twice that year. The new phone could wait.
I skipped a truck accessory and used the money for Dad's cabin weekend. We played cards after dinner.

shared_items.label: How I mean things
shared_items.statement: I usually say the point before I explain the feeling.

shared_items.label: What feels like care
shared_items.statement: Making a plan with me and keeping it feels caring.

shared_items.label: How to bring something up with me
shared_items.statement: Ask one clear question and stay with my answer.
